note: Schedule VII of the Companies Act 2013, the statutory list of activities a CSR spend may fall under. Clause numbering is the Act's own; wording is condensed from the Act and the MCA's later amendments. This is the vocabulary funder_activity.csr_sector_id points at, so a funder's own words for a theme can be normalised without inventing a category.
